?Court No. - 28
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 606 of 2020
Revisionist :- Kariau

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- Ravi Kant Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
1.

This revision has been filed against the order dated 08.10.2020 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge/ Court No.1, Pratapgarh in Criminal Appeal No.27 of 2019 filed by the revisionist against the order dated 28.07.2019 passed by A.C.J.M., Court No.13, Pratapgarh, in Complaint Case No.224 of 2006 under Section 7/16(1-A)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/ Court No.1, Pratapgarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned trial Court had convicted the accused-revisionist and sentenced him for one year's simple imprisonment with fine of Rs.1,000/- and in the event of non payment of fine, further imprisonment of 10 days.

2. Sample of milk from the accused-revisionist was taken and sent for examination and it was found that the sample contained 4.6% Milk Fat and 7.75% Milk Solid Non-Fat against prescribed standard of 8.5% as laid down by the legislature.
3. Two courts below have considered the evidence and have come to the concurrent finding of fact that the accused-revisionist had adulterated the milk being sold by him.
Kariau vs State Of U.P. on 25 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163874014/
1
4. I have gone through two judgments of the Courts below and do not find any error of law or jurisdiction or on facts by the Courts below.

However, considering the fact that the incident is of the year 1999 and substantial time has expired i.e. 21 years from the date of the incident, it would be appropriate to reduce the sentence to minimum of the sentence prescribed i.e. 6 months.

However,
in respect of fine, no modification is required.
Thus, sentence of the accused-revisionist is reduced from one year to six months.
5. With reduction of sentence, the present revision stands disposed of finally.
